# awscc_ecs_gateway_cluster_associations (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::ECS::GatewayClusterAssociations, which associates an ECS Gateway with an ECS Cluster.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster` (String) The name or full Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the cluster to associate the gateway with.
- `gateway` (String) The name or full Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the gateway to associate with the cluster.

### Read-Only

- `cluster_arn` (String) The full Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the associated cluster.
- `gateway_arn` (String) The full Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the associated gateway.
- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `status` (String) The status of the association.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ecs_gateway_cluster_associations.example
  identity = {
    gateway = "gateway"
    cluster = "cluster"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `cluster` (String) The name or full Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the cluster to associate the gateway with
- `gateway` (String) The name or full Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the gateway to associate with the cluster

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ecs_gateway_cluster_associations.example
  id = "gateway|cluster"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_ecs_gateway_cluster_associations.example "gateway|cluster"
```
